```{python}
import gzip

import pandas as pd

from Bio import SeqIO
```


```{python}
df = pd.read_csv(
    "data/2024_Tylototriton_vietnamensis_Wild_Genomes/Linh_Analysis/contaminant_screening/fcs_gx_screening/T_vietnamensis_fcs_gx_contaminants.tabular.tsv",
    sep="\t",
    comment="#",
)
df.head()
```


```{python}
taxa_counts = df["top_tax_name"].value_counts()
taxa_counts
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
bird_ids = set(df.loc[df["top_tax_name"] == "Taeniopygia guttata", "seq_id"])

assembly = "data/2024_Tylototriton_vietnamensis_Wild_Genomes/Linh_Analysis/assemblies/01_init_prim_hifi_asm/T_vietnamensis.p_ctg.fa.gz"
out_fa = "data/2024_Tylototriton_vietnamensis_Wild_Genomes/Linh_Analysis/contaminant_screening/T_vietnamensis_bird_contaminants.fa"

lengths = {}


def select(path, wanted):
    with gzip.open(path, "rt") as handle:
        for record in SeqIO.parse(handle, "fasta"):
            if record.id in wanted:
                lengths[record.id] = len(record.seq)
                yield record


n = SeqIO.write(select(assembly, bird_ids), out_fa, "fasta")

missing = bird_ids - lengths.keys()
if missing:
    raise ValueError(
        f"{len(missing)} of {len(bird_ids)} contigs not found in the assembly. "
        f"First 5: {sorted(missing)[:5]}"
    )

print(f"{n} contigs written ({len(bird_ids)} expected)")
```


Next, run genome_qc.smk Snakemake workflow on the `T_vietnamensis_bird_contaminants.fa` file
to get sequence stats, read depth and may be BUSCO. Later we will align it back to 
the Pleurodeles watl genome if needed


```{python}
summary = pd.read_csv(
    "data/2024_Tylototriton_vietnamensis_Wild_Genomes/Linh_Analysis/results/production_run/genome_qc/mosdepth/01_init_prim_hifi_asm/01_init_prim_hifi_asm.hifi.mosdepth.summary.txt",
    sep="\t",
)

summary = summary[~summary["chrom"].str.endswith(("total", "_region"))]
summary["flagged"] = summary["chrom"].isin(bird_ids)

summary.groupby("flagged")["mean"].describe()
```


```{python}
summary["bin"] = pd.cut(summary["length"], [0, 1e4, 5e4, 2e5, 1e6, 1e9])
summary.groupby(["bin", "flagged"], observed=True)["mean"].median().unstack()
```


```{python}
stats = (
    summary.groupby(["bin", "flagged"], observed=True)
    .agg(n=("mean", "size"), median_cov=("mean", "median"), bp=("length", "sum"))
    .unstack()
)
stats

summary.groupby("flagged")["length"].sum() / 1e9
```
